# Digi Witch

> Digi Witch is a free mobile app for iPhone and Android: a daily horoscope with love, work and energy, the Moon phase, a tarot card of the day, numerology and a dream dictionary. It is meant as inspiration and entertainment, not as prediction or advice.

- Works without creating an account.
- Every calculation (numerology, horoscope) is shown step by step.
- Home-screen widgets show the day at a glance.
- Available in Polish, English, German, French, Spanish, Ukrainian, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch.
- The app is not released yet; store links will appear on the website.

## Links

- [Website](https://digi-witch.com/): features, privacy and download
